MECA.TITLE: Construction and Operation of Tilt & Telescopic Mechanism

ITEM.PTXT: The tilt mechanism has an adjustment range of 15mm up and down from the neutral position for a total of 30mm, and the telescopic mechanism has an adjustment range of 20mm forward and rearward from the neutral position for a total of 40mm.
The tilt & telescopic operation lever is provided at 1 location, improving operability for the driver.
